title: Ivan IV is crowned the first Tsar of All Russia
summary: Grand Prince Ivan IV of Moscow was crowned in the Kremlin's Cathedral of the Dormition with the new title of Tsar.
reason: Moscow's rulers presented themselves as heirs of Byzantium and wanted a title equal to that of an emperor.
significance: It created the Tsardom of Russia, the autocratic state that lasted until 1917.
place: Cathedral of the Dormition, Moscow Kremlin, Russia
